# GitHub brand artwork

The hero and lifecycle graphics follow the existing Telomere website:

- Paper `#f0eee9`, ink `#191919`, orange `#fc5d24`.
- Original project mark from `website/dist/assets/brand/mark.svg`.
- Existing Inter and Inter Display letterforms from the website font assets.
- Segmented meter, fine rules and numbered stages from the site's visual vocabulary.

SVG lettering is outlined so GitHub does not need external fonts. The files contain no scripts, external references or embedded web fonts. `manifest.json` records font-source and generated-asset hashes. `<picture>` selects the matching light or dark artwork in the repository README.

`social-preview.png` is 1280 × 640 and is prepared for the repository's social preview setting. Its editable vector counterpart is `social-preview.svg`.

Telomere marks and brand artwork remain reserved to the project as described in the root third-party notices.
